title: Alzheimer’s disease: function deep-dive (R-10022)
description: Alzheimer’s disease is a neurological disorder of the nervous system. Its role: progressive dementia marked by neuron death in the hippocampus and cortex; amyloid plaques and tau tangles are hallmarks. Key fact: the most common cause of dementia in the elderly. Understanding this function explains why Alzheimer’s disease matters across neurological disorders research. Closely associated with memory loss, hippocampus, and dementia.
